payload.text: Claude Usage 1.18 (mainline, in /Applications since 2026-11-17) keeps each Keychain item's first email for its whole run. After a ccusage switch, its account names are stale until it restarts, and the shared item's history mixes the accounts seated there. Until PR #18 ships upstream, read accounts from ccusage, not from Claude Usage, and expect hv to restart Claude Usage after a switch.
